description: This file defines a custom exception class 'CoapResultException' used for representing CoAP failure results. It includes constructors for setting an error code and optional message, and a method to retrieve the error code.

classes.name: CoapResultException
classes.description: A dedicated exception for CoAP failures, includes constructors with error code and message, and a method to retrieve the error code.

methods.name: CoapResultException(int errorCode)
methods.description: Constructs a new CoapResultException with the specified error code.

methods.name: CoapResultException(int errorCode, String message)
methods.description: Constructs a new CoapResultException with the specified error code and message.

methods.name: getErrorCode()
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with this exception.
